insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Orianna is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Orianna in 17/32 games (53%): 3 picks (1-2) and 14 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ambessa? They go Gnar
insights.text: Ambessa is a G1 favorite (8/20 G1s, played by Tracyn). In the 10 later games where it was burned or banned, Tracyn went to Gnar (3/10) and Rumble (2/10).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Varus against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Varus against them in 16/32 games (50%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Orianna
insights.text: Orianna is their first ban in 10/32 games (31%). Expect it gone before your first pick.
